reference: Approved mockup Accounts.tsx controls and SettingsDialogs.tsx RenameDialog (420px) and accounts-remove Confirm (460px), compared in a private headless browser. Qt AccountsPage::rename/renameNext, default and remove semantics.
fixture: Normal embedded-assets Tauri app, fresh private D-Bus/Xvfb/HOME/XDG/TMPDIR/TMUX_TMPDIR and child environment built from scratch; native hgs fixture with local workstation and peer studio profiles sharing a verified account identity. No real accounts, credentials, agents or services changed.

walk.rename: Escape cancels without an effect. Confirm renames the captured local and peer profiles once each with revision r1 and exact machine guards. An unchanged name closes without a write.
walk.default: Peer studio becomes default at revision r2; local profile remains non-default.
walk.remove: Cancel makes no write. Confirm removes only studio profile at revision r3; local remains listed.
walk.stale: A separately changed private catalog (r100) refuses the old dialog after its fresh read. Four total mutation calls remain; no replay. Explicit Refresh shows the outside change.
walk.focus: Rename input starts selected; Cancel is focused for removal, Escape returns to the original action.
walk.success_placement: Passing captions appear inside the existing selected account card, as the mockup accountNotice Status; failures use the existing sticky notice bus. Selecting an account/machine clears the passing caption.

checks.frontend: Type check, full Vitest 2115 passed plus 1 skipped, production build
checks.core: All-target Clippy; 2 pure binding/argument tests and 3 real fake-CLI integration tests
checks.tauri: All-target Clippy default/media/video/no-default-features and Windows MSVC media cross-Clippy; 39 screens tests pass (including 7 account edit tests)

contracts: Native-only snapshots retain the account group and exact profile/machine/catalog revision. Eight pending handles maximum; handles are consumed before an effect and never retried.
Fresh guarded catalog read verifies profile provider, home and credential revision; the mutation repeats the physical machine guard and hgs revision CAS.
A failed rename stops the remaining group queue as Qt does. Multiple profiles on one machine advance only through this plan’s confirmed revisions; external changes still refuse.
Edits borrow the existing screens catalog slot. Mutations and list reads share completion, queued refresh and New session waiter notification; mutation errors use the notice bus.

scope.slice: Rename/default/remove only. Permissions/model and add/auth/install remain next.
